text:
Sam W: Kicking off thread — Acme POC asking for a temporary per-token override: embeddings $0.0005/token, generation $0.0012/token for a 90‑day POC. Also asking to waive the min charge for month 1. Any immediate objections?

Maria G: They estimate ~2B tokens total during the POC window. That discount is ~40% off hosted list. Need Deal Desk + Finance OK.

Raj P: Can we do a 'rate-bridge' instead of a flat discount? e.g., POC rate for first 30d, 75% of difference for next 30d, then normal tier after that. Also propose an SLO credit if 99.9% latency > 300ms for >1h.

Claire L: @Raj P need a quick $ impact calc to decide on a waiver. Can someone drop numbers?

Sam W: Quick calc below (rough):
```
Scenario A - POC flat rate:
2,000,000,000 tokens * $0.0005 = $1,000,000 (embeds assumed portion of total)
If generation portion 500M tokens * $0.0012 = $600,000
Total ~ $1.6M over 90d (~$533k/mo)

Scenario B - list price (~no discount):
2B * $0.0009 (embeds list) = $1.8M + 500M * $0.002 = $1.0M -> ~$2.8M

Delta saved by discount ~ $1.2M over 90d
```

Claire L: Okay — finance comfortable if we get a post-POC commitment: suggest a minimum $10k/mo for 6 months starting month 4. We can waive month 1 min once. Approve conditional on usage reporting (daily) and invoice visibility.

Elaine (Eng): Heads up — if their traffic spikes we may hit burst capacity. Need to ensure routing to cheaper variants + autoscaling policies are explicit. Also need a billing chargeback for burst GPU hours.

Sam W: We'll add an explicit routing fallback: route to quantized gen-variant when latency <100ms SLA at risk, plus prefix caching. For burst chargeback: propose billable burst at list rates beyond reserved cap. Also propose SLO credit: 1% of monthly invoice per hour of major outage (capped at 10%).

Deals Bot: Deal registered as CR-2026-451. Approval required from managers: @Claire L and @Elaine (Eng). Escalation ETA: EOD today.

Claire L: I approve conditionally — include: 1) POC rate-bridge clause, 2) 30d termination notice, 3) daily usage feed, 4) post-POC min $10k/mo for 6 months.

Maria G: I'll loop in Legal to draft the POC clause and ping VP if we exceed 50% effective discount. Can't exceed that threshold without VP sign-off.

Sam W: Thanks — I'll update the quote template and include the routing/fallback language and SLO credit. Escalate to VP only if required. :thumbsup:

Maria G: I'll update CRM with CR-2026-451 and add notes on the agreed conditional approvals.

Sam W: Final ask — @Claire L / @Elaine, please confirm in thread when you file approvals so we can send the POC quote to Acme.

Claire L: Confirmed — filed approval in internal portal.

Elaine (Eng): Confirmed — engineering reviewed and added routing/chargeback notes to the SOW.

Sam W: Great, thanks everyone. Sending quote after Legal adds clause.
